name: io.github.qingchejun/mindlm-mcp
description: Turn text, web pages and PDFs into interactive mind maps. MCP server + CLI, no API key.

packageArguments.description: Starts the MCP server on stdio.

environmentVariables.name: MINDMAP_OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Directory for exported HTML mind maps. Defaults to ./mindmaps.

environmentVariables.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set it to let the server write outlines with a model itself instead of handing a draft back to the client.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Same as ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Defaults to https://api.openai.com/v1.

environmentVariables.name: MINDMAP_LLM_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Model name. Required when using an OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: MINDMAP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to true to let url_to_mindmap reach loopback and private addresses. Off by default.
